elements.text:
1. Trip plans split across chats, booking sites and spreadsheets.
2. Agreed places disappear in long conversations.
3. Manual bill splits lose cents and hide who owes whom.
4. Generic suggestions ignore preferences, access and travel time.
5. Safety and insurance details sit apart from the trip.

elements.name: Rounded Rectangle 40
elements.text:
1. Plan, chat, vote and split costs together.
2. Turn group chat into reviewed trip ideas.
3. Optimise routes and book travel securely.
4. Connect travellers, insurers and admins.

elements.name: Rounded Rectangle 52
elements.text:
TARGET USERS
Friends, families and student travellers; insurance partners and administrators.

DEVELOPMENT
Feature-based iterations; API limits drove an in-house char-TF-IDF/LogReg model trained with public dialogues.

ARCHITECTURE
Flutter/Dart app + HTML/JS console → Firebase Auth, Firestore, Storage and Node.js Cloud Functions.

CONSOLE + SERVICES
Moderates community; manages places, plans, claims, refunds and reports. Duffel/RollingGo, OSM (Wikipedia photo fallback), Stripe/PayPal, OpenAI moderation.

REQUIREMENTS
Android 8+ phone, internet and GPS for location features; Chrome/Edge console. Dev: Windows 10/11, 8 GB RAM.
Service model: partner insurance commissions and flight/hotel checkout.

elements.name: Rounded Rectangle 55
elements.text:
AI SUMMARY — 12-step, consent-gated; extract places + stance, check flights/hotels; user applies suggestions.


OPTIMISE — Two-opt groups district stops and cuts travel time; meals, hours and bookings stay fixed.


RECOMMEND — Budget/access/open-now filters; weighted preference, rating, distance and schedule score.


VOTE + COSTS — Transactions secure votes; largest-remainder cents keep equal/custom/itemised totals exact.


TESTS — 76/83 pass; 3 fail; 4 unrun (Oct 2026).

elements.name: Rounded Rectangle 92
elements.text: Group travel spans chats, booking sites and spreadsheets, obscuring decisions, itineraries and costs. This project links a Flutter app and admin/partner web console through Firebase for chat summaries, voting, route planning, bookings, insurance, community and expense tracking. Unit, integration, Cloud Function and web tests accompany public-dialogue results: 92.5% travel accuracy, 97.6% off-topic recognition.
